get.description:
List recorded run costs per month, vendor, and project for costs that ended in the `[start, end)` window.

A cost is placed in the UTC month it ended. That is its `usage_end`, else its run's `finished_at`, else its run's
`started_at`.

A cost counts under its run's newest project link. Runs with no project return null project fields.

`runs` lists every run alive during the window or holding a cost in it, with its project. Model spend dated in the
window can then join to its project whatever day its run started.

A run is alive if it started before `end` and finished on or after `start`, or is still in progress or stopping.
